workload: Unchanged existing scripts/bench-ground-waypoints.mjs: 200 followers, 20 warmups, 50 second-waypoint appends, 600 full simulation turns. Alternating separate Node processes, three pairs. Current uncommitted source versus baseline; no GPU or hardware FPS conclusion. Ground workload checks command and route cleanup; new mixed-order behavior has separate browser timing.

runs.scope: CPU only: append a second shared ground order to 200 already moving people, including native current-order restart and route planning; separately time 600 complete turns to settled arrival. Existing order pool, shared route cache and marching controller reused. No per-render waypoint processing or second queue. This is added functionality, not an equivalent before/after speedup or a GPU/FPS benchmark.
